C0979.title: Naraka: Bladepoint to Penalize Players Who Queue with Cheaters
C0979.summary: Naraka Bladepoint officials had banned about 6,000 cheating players and upgraded the anti-cheat system. Players reported that enforcement against users who intentionally teamed with cheaters to gain rank was less effective than enforcement against direct cheaters. The article argued that intentional teaming should be distinguished from temporary matchmaking and that intentional ride-along cheating should receive stronger penalties, otherwise the cheat ecosystem would be encouraged.
